_provenance.readout: eager forward; last-four-block attention at the final position, mean over heads and blocks; mass summed over each option line's tokens
_provenance.layer_pooling: mean over the last four blocks
_provenance.tie_rule: first maximum by natural option index

config.tie_rule: first maximum by natural option index
config.layer_pooling: mean over the last four blocks
config.span_rule: tokens fully inside each option line '{code}. {text}'
config.mass_aggregation: sum of head-pooled attention over the span
config.code_scheme: A-Z, a-z, then single-character symbols, one code per option
config.noul_rendering: two options: A. no / B. yes

length_guard.definition: choice and score items; longest option text by characters, ties to the lowest natural index
